name: 品牌（资产/评估/审计）体系

map.输入品牌财务和市场指标，按Interbrand模型评估品牌资产价值: Enter brand financial and market metrics to assess brand equity value with the Interbrand model
map.一笔品牌资产现值估算: One brand equity present value estimate
map.品牌贡献率怎么定？: How is the brand contribution rate set?
map.用剔除品牌因素前后的利润差除以总利润，或按行业基准（快消约 25%–40%）校准: Divide the profit difference before and after removing brand factors by total profit, or calibrate against an industry benchmark (about 25%-40% for fast-moving consumer goods); combine this with the company's own history and comparable firms.
map.Interbrand模型通过品牌净利润折现计算品牌资产价值: Interbrand Model discounts brand net profit to obtain brand equity value
map.品牌贡献率反映品牌对购买决策的影响程度: The brand contribution rate reflects how much the brand influences purchase decisions
map.折现率应考虑无风险利率和品牌风险溢价: The discount rate should allow for the risk-free rate and a brand risk premium
map.品牌审计应定期进行，建议每2-3年评估一次: Brand audits should be repeated regularly, every 2-3 years is recommended
map.品牌资产评估工具，基于Interbrand模型计算品牌净利润现值，评估品牌强度等: Brand equity assessment tool: based on the Interbrand model it discounts brand net profit to present value and grades brand strength and asset value.
map.品牌年净利润 = 年净利润 × 品牌贡献率 ÷ 100: Annual brand net profit = annual net profit × brand contribution rate ÷ 100
map.品牌价值 = Σ 品牌年净利润 ÷ (1 + 调整后折现率)^i（i = 1 至: Brand value = Σ annual brand net profit ÷ (1 + adjusted discount rate)^i (i = 1 to evaluation years)
map.分级：≥80 顶级品牌｜≥60 强势品牌｜≥40 成长品牌｜<40 弱势品牌: Grading: ≥80 top brand | ≥60 strong brand | ≥40 growing brand | <40 weak brand
map.品牌强度 7 维评分（每项 0–10 分，括号内为 Interbrand 权重）: Seven-dimension brand strength scoring (0-10 per dimension; Interbrand weights in brackets)
map.品牌强度 = Σ(维度得分 ÷ 10 × 维度权重)（领导力 25%、稳定力 1: Brand strength = Σ(dimension score ÷ 10 × weight) (leadership 25%, stability 15%, market 10%, international scope 25%, trend 10%, support 10%, protection 5%)
map.调整后折现率 = 折现率 ÷ 100 + (1 − 品牌强度) × 0.05: Adjusted discount rate = discount rate ÷ 100 + (1 − brand strength) × 0.05
map.品牌强度按 7 维加权：领导力 25%、稳定力 15%、市场力 10%、国际化: Brand strength is weighted across seven dimensions: leadership 25%, stability 15%, market 10%, international scope 25%, trend 10%, support 10%, protection 5%
map.品牌收购或授权谈判时，给品牌单独估一个可报价的数；7 维评分同时作为尽调清单，暴: Value a brand separately when negotiating an acquisition or licensing deal; the seven scores double as a due-diligence checklist that exposes weak spots.
map.融资路演或年报披露，以一致标准量化并披露无形资产价值，逐年复评 7 个维度观察品: Quantify and disclose intangible asset value on a consistent basis for funding roadshows or annual reports, re-scoring the seven dimensions each year to track brand health.
map.集团内部审计考核品牌部门对利润的真实贡献：按维度打分、加权成强度，再折算进折现率: Audit internally how much the brand function really contributes to profit: score each dimension, weight it into a strength factor and fold it into the discount rate.
map.品牌年净利润 1000 万元、品牌贡献率 30% → 品牌净利润 300 万元；: Annual brand net profit 10 million CNY at a 30% contribution rate gives 3 million CNY; the weighted seven-dimension score is 0.80 (80/100); with a 10% discount rate over 5 years the adjusted rate is 10% + (1 − 0.8) × 5% = 11%, so the present value is 300 × Σ(1.11⁻ⁱ, i = 1…5) ≈ 11.09 million CNY.
map.强度评分对估值的影响: How the strength score moves the valuation
map.同样 300 万品牌净利润，品牌强度从 0.6 提到 0.9，调整后折现率由 1: With the same 3 million CNY of brand net profit, raising brand strength from 0.6 to 0.9 cuts the adjusted discount rate from 12% to 10.5% and lifts the 5-year present value from about 10.81 million to 11.23 million CNY (about +4%); the longer the horizon, the bigger the effect.
map.品牌强度评分怎么来？: How is the brand strength score derived?
map.7 个维度各打 0–10 分，分别乘以领导力 25%、稳定力 15%、市场力 1: Score each of the seven dimensions from 0 to 10, multiply by the weights (leadership 25%, stability 15%, market 10%, international scope 25%, trend 10%, support 10%, protection 5%), sum them and convert to a 0-100 score; a higher score means a lower discount rate and a higher valuation.
map.为什么市场占有率不直接参与估值？: Why is market share not a direct input?
map.Interbrand 体系里市场份额属于「市场力」维度的一个观察项，已体现在该维: In the Interbrand framework market share is one observation inside the market dimension and is already reflected in that score; multiplying by it again would double-count, so it is not a separate input.
map.本工具按 Interbrand 思路，用品牌年净利润 × 品牌贡献率得到品牌净利: This tool follows the Interbrand approach: annual brand net profit × brand contribution rate gives brand net profit; brand strength is weighted across leadership, stability, market, international scope, trend, support and protection, and converted into an adjusted discount rate; brand net profit over the forecast horizon is then discounted and summed to obtain the present value of brand equity. It runs entirely in the browser, so input data never leaves it. Results are for management reference and investor communication only; formal financial disclosure must comply with accounting standards and be audited.
